t: Low odour, low modulus sealant. Neutral curing with a primerless adhesion to a variety of materials including glass, plastics, masonry substrates, metals and woods. Highly flexible with excellent movement capability and ideal for sealing around perimeter of windows and door frames or joints. Weather and temperature-resistant. Can also be used on HVAC ducting, pipework and draining joints. For interior and exterior use.
b: Suitable for Use on Most Building Substrates, Glazing, Kitchens, Bathrooms & Industrial Applications
